mapper.select: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM SYSTEM_SETTING WHERE SETTING_KEY = #{key}
SELECT SETTING_KEY AS `key`, SETTING_VALUE AS `value`, UPDATED_AT AS `updatedAt`, UPDATED_BY AS `updatedBy` FROM SYSTEM_SETTING ORDER BY SETTING_KEY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYSTEM_SETTING (SETTING_KEY, SETTING_VALUE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}, NOW(), #{actor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SETTING_VALUE = VALUES(SETTING_VALUE), UPDATED_AT = VALUES(UPDATED_AT), UPDATED_BY = VALUES(UPDATED_BY)
